canon_source: Provided Xylos lore attachments; source details left open where unspecified.

terms.canonical_definition: Energy born when fragments of the Aethel Shard resonated with Xylos's molten core.
terms.public_knowledge: A powerful energy associated with Xylos and its altered ecology.
terms.restricted_knowledge: The complete mechanism and any consciousness within it are not established canon.
terms.unknown_truth: The complete mechanism and any consciousness within it are not established canon.
terms.notes: Keep explanations tied to observed effects.

terms.canonical_definition: A colossal crystalline asteroid that shattered on Xylos; its fragments remain embedded in the planet.
terms.public_knowledge: A source of Aethel fragments and a focus of religious and scientific claims.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Whether it has intention or a unified mind is not proven.
terms.unknown_truth: Whether it has intention or a unified mind is not proven.
terms.notes: Shard sentience claims remain belief or hypothesis.

terms.canonical_definition: Aethelgardian device that draws raw Aethel from Shard fragments; later repaired by the Concordium.
terms.public_knowledge: A damaged ancient system, repaired and operated by Concordium; its safety is politically contested.
terms.restricted_knowledge: The source lore says it overloaded during the Great Severance; current operation's full risk is unspecified.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.
terms.notes: Do not treat every current disturbance as another overload without evidence.

terms.canonical_definition: A platform built around the Aethel Shard impact epicenter and housing the Siphon.
terms.public_knowledge: Ancient infrastructure at the heart of Nexus and planetary politics.
terms.restricted_knowledge: The full extent of lower systems remains unknown.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.
terms.notes: Distinguish the ancient structure from Nexus's modern city.

terms.canonical_definition: Rare substance refined from raw Aethel at the Aethel Forge.
terms.public_knowledge: A high-value catalyst, strategic resource, and source of faction conflict.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Its ultimate physical limits are not specified.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.
terms.notes: NPCs may disagree over who should control it.

terms.canonical_definition: Catastrophe caused when Aethelgardians pushed the Siphon beyond its limits, overloading it and shattering Shard fragments.
terms.public_knowledge: A civilization-ending event tied to dangerous Siphon use.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Individual mechanisms and culpability may remain disputed in-world.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.

terms.canonical_definition: Political split of the Concordium that gave rise to Arcanum Seekers, Iron Hegemony, and Meridian Cartel.
terms.public_knowledge: A later fracture in settler governance and faction politics.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Exact dates and individual responsibility are unspecified.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.

terms.canonical_definition: Used by Old Man Kael in roster dialogue; the supplied canon does not define it.
terms.public_knowledge: A local expression or historical claim of uncertain reference.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Whether it is a third event, nickname, or error is unresolved.
terms.unknown_truth: Whether it is a third event, nickname, or error is unresolved.
terms.notes: Retain as character terminology pending author decision.

terms.canonical_definition: Civilization that harnessed Aethel and built the Cradle, Siphon, Forge, and cities of Aethelgard.
terms.public_knowledge: An ancient civilization whose ruins and abandoned technology remain on Xylos.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Last descendants are said to live in hiding; specific identities are unknown.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.

terms.canonical_definition: Contested region around the ancient Aethel Cradle.
terms.public_knowledge: A hazardous frontier connected to old infrastructure and competing claims.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Detailed historical function beyond proximity to the Cradle is unclear.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.

terms.canonical_definition: Concordium capital built around the Aethel Cradle after the Siphon was repaired.
terms.public_knowledge: A major city and political center.
terms.restricted_knowledge: Claims of full control over the whole Cradle are contested by other factions.
terms.unknown_truth: Further detail remains unspecified in supplied source lore.
terms.notes: Do not equate Nexus with NEXUS_CORE region automatically.

terms.canonical_definition: A world in the Aethelgard System altered by Aethel Shard impact and later inhabited by settlers and off-world powers.
terms.public_knowledge: A scarred but inhabited planet rich in Aethel and ancient ruins.
